children: FedEx terminated Michael B. Lyons, Executive Vice President – Chief Specialized Services and Commercial Officer, after finding he violated the company’s Code of Conduct.
FedEx ended Mr. Lyons’s employment following an internal investigation that found Code of Conduct violations.
The company said the conduct did not affect financial reporting, performance, internal controls, strategy, or customer relationships.
Mr. Lyons’s responsibilities are being transitioned to FedEx executive leadership during a comprehensive search for a replacement.
